policy: A gate is not marked PROVEN or EQUIVALENT without executable evidence; physical, external-model, device, and semantic-equivalence gates remain BLOCKED when not run.

gates.name: Baseline correctness / equivalence
gates.scope: Deterministic fixture equivalence; not whole-system semantic equivalence.

gates.name: Logical-scale benchmark
gates.scope: 2,000,000 logical parameters with selective examination; not 10^8.

gates.name: Sparsity surface
gates.scope: 0,10,25,50,75,100 percent sweep.

gates.name: Prediction-accuracy surface
gates.scope: 0,25,50,75,90,100 percent sweep with parameter-level hits and corrections.

gates.name: Prediction-adversarial benchmark
gates.scope: Hostile predictions are corrected and cannot become authoritative state.

gates.name: Dependency-topology benchmark
gates.scope: Basic dependency selection exists; full topology family sweep not executed.

gates.name: Dynamic-parameter benchmark
gates.scope: Canonicalization, prediction, observation, revision, provenance, and open-ended maps tested; deletion/domain mutation matrix incomplete.

gates.name: Initiative-cluster benchmark
gates.scope: Selective recalculation and linked-cluster composability tested; full 10,000 topology campaign not executed.

gates.name: Reflexor latency decomposition
gates.scope: Lifecycle exists; per-stage timing matrix not yet captured.

gates.name: Reactive versus predictive benchmark
gates.scope: Synthetic three-path microbenchmark; not real training.

gates.name: Predictive break-even benchmark
gates.scope: Surface records overhead but does not establish a general crossover.

gates.name: JIT activation benchmark
gates.scope: Activation, retry, unauthorized, and bounded failure cases tested.

gates.name: Piston-memory scaling benchmark
gates.scope: Bounded aperture and pressure behavior tested; no GB-scale physical run.

gates.name: GhostMemoryBus benchmark
gates.scope: Acquire, release, rotation, stale generation, and same-space protection covered by tests.

gates.name: Storage versus resident-state benchmark
gates.scope: Logical/released/aperture state measured in native fixtures; not physical RAM equivalence.

gates.name: One-shot orchestration scaling
gates.scope: 5,10,100,1,000,10,000 steps at one external interaction.

gates.name: Persistent-learning benchmark
gates.scope: Learning records, priorities, corrections, visited signatures, and terminal states tested.

gates.name: Loop-detection benchmark
gates.scope: Repeated-attempt stopping and deterministic terminal control tested.

gates.name: Proof-boundary benchmark
gates.scope: Prediction, numerical evidence, and single-source evidence cannot promote to independent proof state.

gates.name: Riemann semantic-reflex benchmark
gates.scope: Hypothesis routing, activation, observation, correction, loop control, and proof-state classification tested; RH unresolved.

gates.name: Tokenizer benchmark
gates.scope: No native tokenizer throughput/equivalence campaign captured.

gates.name: Model-intent extraction benchmark
gates.scope: Candidate extraction and canonicalization rejection paths tested.

gates.name: Model-inference integration benchmark
gates.scope: No actual model inference run in this campaign.

gates.name: Training benchmark
gates.scope: Synthetic microbenchmark exists; same-dataset model-training comparison is not established.

gates.name: Training sparsity benchmark
gates.scope: No real optimizer/dataset training sweep.

gates.name: Training prediction benchmark
gates.scope: Execution prediction surface is not training evidence.

gates.name: Model-scale benchmark
gates.scope: Logical scale and bounded active window measured in native fixtures.

gates.name: Long-context benchmark
gates.scope: Compact reconstruction exists; no conventional-context equivalence sweep.

gates.name: Multi-objective benchmark
gates.scope: Single-objective trajectory only.

gates.name: Concurrent-agent benchmark
gates.scope: Isolation primitives exist; concurrent contention campaign not executed.

gates.name: Fault-injection benchmark
gates.scope: Malformed, unauthorized, stale, and unresolved paths fail closed; full corruption matrix incomplete.

gates.name: Crash/recovery benchmark
gates.scope: Deterministic reconstruction is tested; process-kill recovery points are not.

gates.name: Determinism benchmark
gates.scope: Deterministic replay and final-result equivalence tested in fixtures.

gates.name: Reproducibility benchmark
gates.scope: Fresh reconstruction clone under Rust 1.96.0 passed 72 Braxon-core library tests; full-system package and all-workspace acceptance remain outside this gate.

gates.name: Memory-pressure benchmark
gates.scope: Bounded pressure and fail-closed aperture tests; not device telemetry.

gates.name: Thermal/resource benchmark
gates.scope: Requires physical Android device telemetry.

gates.name: Android 16 acceptance
gates.scope: No physical non-rooted Samsung Galaxy A17 acceptance run.

gates.name: Guile semantic-equivalence benchmark
gates.scope: Catalog/intent reconstruction is not representative semantic equivalence.

gates.name: Zig semantic-equivalence benchmark
gates.scope: Catalog/intent reconstruction is not representative semantic equivalence.

gates.name: Companion-tool equivalence benchmark
gates.scope: Tool intent catalog is not a complete reference-equivalence suite.

gates.name: Universal architecture audit
gates.scope: Repository audit evidence exists; universal absence of every bypass is not a theorem.

gates.name: Global WOWAS audit
gates.scope: Payload/compiler controls exist; universal subsystem compliance is not completed.

gates.name: Global semantic-authority audit
gates.scope: Native authority boundaries are tested in covered paths; universal audit remains incomplete.

gates.name: Universal migration audit
gates.scope: Historical disposition inventory exists; every migration gate is not proven complete.

gates.name: Full-system clean-room build
gates.scope: Fresh sparse reconstruction clone under Rust 1.96.0; cargo test --workspace --all-targets passed 139 tests; release packaging and physical acceptance remain outside this gate.
